name: Kosher Kush
summary: Kosher Kush is a [[kind:cut|cut]] of [[og-kush|OG Kush]] from Los Angeles, kept as a clone before [[breeder:DNA Genetics]] offered it as seed. It won Best Indica at the High Times Cannabis Cup in 2010 and 2011, and Best Strain in 2011.

sources.title: Kosher Kush
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: confirms OG Kush as parent, Los Angeles, DNA Genetics, the clone-only start, and the 2010–2011 Cup wins.

sources.title: Kosher Kush
sources.note: Gives 9–10 weeks of flowering, indoors and out.
